CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue appears to be about a problem with PhpStorm/IDEA IDE when using Xdebug for PHP debugging. The issue describes that when using the same port for Xdebug monitoring, it prevents executing a second PHP command. This is a configuration/usage issue related to how Xdebug works with the IDE. 

To verify a solution to this problem, one would need to understand how Xdebug port configuration works and how to properly set up multiple debugging sessions. This is a conceptual issue that can be analyzed and verified through documentation and understanding of how Xdebug handles connections, rather than needing to actually build and run code. The solution would likely involve configuring different ports for different debugging sessions or implementing proper session management.

Since this is primarily a configuration and usage issue with an IDE and debugging tool, it can be verified through documentation analysis and understanding of the tools' behavior without needing to set up a build environment.
